_comment: Curated download candidates. Every sha256 and fileBytes here was read from
the HuggingFace LFS pointer for that exact file, not estimated.
Repositories are chosen for being ungated. Google's own gemma GGUF repos
require an accepted licence and a bearer token, which an offline-first app
with no account cannot satisfy, so the ggml-org mirrors are used instead.
estimatedResidentBytes IS a guess: file size plus a coarse allowance for the
KV cache at contextTokens. Replacing these with measurements on the target
device is P10's job -- see docs/25-inference.md section 6, which is explicit
that the model list is not settled until it has been measured.

models.note: Quantisation-aware trained, so Q4 costs less quality than a post-hoc quant.
The largest candidate. Best reasoning of the three, tightest memory fit.
The floor. Included to find where planning ability breaks down, not because it is expected to pass.
